findings.source: ZKSyncAutomationRegistryBase2_3._updateTransmitters: s_signersList = signers; s_transmittersList = transmitters (address[] memory -> storage)
findings.issue: The memory-to-storage array assignment is printed as a loop with a reversed test, and its counter is then reused as an absolute slot (s + sha3(13)) for the tail clearing.
findings.rule: A loop storing stor[a + i] = uint160(mem[b + 32i]) for i < n, with no other effect, is the copy 'stor13[0 len n] = mem[b len 32n]' (address-cleaned); print the tail clear as deleting elements n..old_length-1.

findings.source: abi.encode of report data, events with config arrays, the performUpkeep calls and LINK/billing token transfers
findings.issue: As in c00409: after the first symbolic allocation, call inputs and event data are raw memory and copies stay loops (about 30); the decoded report arrays are read through two levels of pointers with a bounds check before each access (58 Panic(50) tests, most implied by the loop test).
findings.rule: Free-memory-pointer non-aliasing (c00409) for stores through mload(0x40); drop 'if i >= mem[p]: panic' when the enclosing loop tests i against the same unchanged mem[p].

findings.source: ZKSyncAutomationRegistryBase2_3.sol:798 for (uint256 idx = 4; idx < 15; idx++) if (rawID[idx] != empty) return Trigger.CONDITION; return Trigger(uint8(rawID[15]));
findings.issue: A counted loop with an early exit is a 'while True' whose bound test sits inside next to the post-loop code.
findings.rule: 'while True: if i >= N: <A>; break ...' is 'while i < N: ...' followed by <A> on the normal exit.

notes: 10 ABI functions plus the fallback (delegates to the logic contracts) reviewed; transmit and setConfig/setConfigTypeSafe (same code, the latter without the onchainConfig bytes decode) reviewed by structure, the small getters/ownership functions read in full. Loops: 11 explicit, all whiles: in transmit the signature-verification loop, _handleReport's two loops and _getTriggerType's byte scan ('while True'); in setConfig the two _setBillingConfig loops, the three _updateTransmitters loops and the two registrar loops (the downward 'for (idx = length; idx > 0; idx--)' as 'while idx'). Implicit: validating decodes, the new array init (rotated, P3), two checked-exp helpers ('while x > 1', readable), two memory-to-storage address-array copies and about 30 encode copies (P7). P18: decoded report struct fields as memory slices. No semantic error found (checked _getTriggerType, the transmitter add/remove bookkeeping, the registrar set rebuild).
summary: Faithful, all 11 loops present; readability suffers from raw memory after allocations, storage array assignments printed as loops with a reused counter, and many redundant bounds checks.
